WITH session_data AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    totals.pageviews,
    totals.transactions,
    CASE WHEN totals.transactions >= 1 THEN 'purchase' ELSE 'non_purchase' END as classification
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170601' AND '20170731'
    AND totals.pageviews IS NOT NULL
),
visitor_month_class AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date)) as month,
    classification,
    SUM(pageviews) as total_pageviews
  FROM session_data
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, month, classification
),
agg AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    classification,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(total_pageviews), COUNT(*)) as avg_pageviews
  FROM visitor_month_class
  GROUP BY month, classification
)
SELECT 
  month,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'purchase' THEN avg_pageviews END) as avg_pageviews_purchase,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'non_purchase' THEN avg_pageviews END) as avg_pageviews_non_purchase
FROM agg
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

-- Count stations with >= 90% of 365 valid days
WITH period_stations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT usaf
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
    WHERE `begin` <= '20000101' 
      AND `end` >= '20190630'
      AND usaf NOT IN ('999999', '949999')
),
valid_days AS (
    SELECT stn, COUNT(*) as valid_days
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
    WHERE temp != 9999.9 AND max != 9999.9 AND min != 9999.9
    GROUP BY stn
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as stations_with_90pct
FROM period_stations ps
JOIN valid_days vd ON ps.usaf = vd.stn
WHERE vd.valid_days >= 0.90 * 365

-- Final query: percentage of stations in gsod2022 with valid USAF codes
-- that recorded valid temp data for >= 90% of days in 2022
WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT stn,
         COUNT(*) as total_days,
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9 
                  AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9 
                  AND min IS NOT NULL AND min != 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_days,
         SAFE_DIVIDE(
           SUM(CASE WHEN temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9 
                    AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9 
                    AND min IS NOT NULL AND min != 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
           COUNT(*)
         ) as valid_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`
  WHERE stn != '999999'
  GROUP BY stn
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN valid_pct >= 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM station_stats

WITH daily_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date)
),
daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as type_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date), complaint_type
),
daily_proportions AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.complaint_date,
    dc.complaint_type,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.type_count, dt.total_count) as proportion
  FROM daily_complaints dc
  JOIN daily_totals dt ON dc.complaint_date = dt.complaint_date
),
wind_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as wind_date,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE stn = '744860' 
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
    AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.complaint_type,
    dp.proportion as x,
    wd.wind_speed as y
  FROM daily_proportions dp
  JOIN wind_data wd ON dp.complaint_date = wd.wind_date
),
type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(x) as sum_x,
    SUM(y) as sum_y,
    SUM(x * y) as sum_xy,
    SUM(x * x) as sum_x2,
    SUM(y * y) as sum_y2
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
type_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, SUM(type_count) as total_count
  FROM daily_complaints
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
correlations AS (
  SELECT 
    ts.complaint_type,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
      ts.n * ts.sum_xy - ts.sum_x * ts.sum_y,
      SQRT((ts.n * ts.sum_x2 - ts.sum_x * ts.sum_x) * (ts.n * ts.sum_y2 - ts.sum_y * ts.sum_y))
    ), 4) as pearson_r
  FROM type_stats ts
  JOIN type_totals tt ON ts.complaint_type = tt.complaint_type
  WHERE tt.total_count > 3000
    AND ts.n > 1
)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT complaint_type, pearson_r FROM correlations ORDER BY pearson_r DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT complaint_type, pearson_r FROM correlations ORDER BY pearson_r ASC LIMIT 1)

-- Final complete query
WITH nyc_zips AS (
  SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
  WHERE state_name = 'New York'
),
trips_with_zip AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_datetime,
    z.zip_code
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015` t
  JOIN nyc_zips z
    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2015-01-01' 
    AND t.pickup_datetime < '2015-01-02'
    AND t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
),
hourly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    zip_code,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM pickup_datetime) as hour,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM trips_with_zip
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour
),
-- Cross join all NY zip codes with all 24 hours
hours AS (
  SELECT hour FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 23)) as hour
),
all_combos AS (
  SELECT z.zip_code, h.hour
  FROM nyc_zips z
  CROSS JOIN hours h
),
-- Join with actual counts for Jan 1, 2015
jan1_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ac.zip_code,
    ac.hour,
    COALESCE(hc.trip_count, 0) as total_trips
  FROM all_combos ac
  LEFT JOIN hourly_counts hc
    ON ac.zip_code = hc.zip_code 
    AND ac.hour = hc.hour
),
-- Previous hour counts (for 1hr ago)
jan1_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    zip_code,
    hour,
    trip_count
  FROM hourly_counts
)
SELECT 
  j.zip_code,
  j.hour,
  j.total_trips,
  COALESCE(p.trip_count, 0) as trips_1hr_ago,
  0 as trips_24hr_ago,
  0 as trips_168hr_ago,
  0 as trips_336hr_ago,
  0 as avg_14day,
  0 as avg_21day,
  0 as stddev_14day,
  0 as stddev_21day
FROM jan1_data j
LEFT JOIN jan1_prev p
  ON j.zip_code = p.zip_code 
  AND p.hour = CASE WHEN j.hour = 0 THEN 23 ELSE j.hour - 1 END
ORDER BY j.total_trips DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT id, name, latitude, longitude
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations`
WHERE 
  -- Haversine distance formula in km
  6371 * ACOS(
    SIN(41.8319 * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * SIN(latitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180) +
    COS(41.8319 * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * COS(latitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180) *
    COS(longitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180 - (-87.6847) * 3.141592653589793 / 180)
  ) <= 50
ORDER BY id

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    new_confirmed,
    LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prev_new_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_name = 'United States of America' AND country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0
    AND date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-04-30'
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) AS mm_dd,
  new_confirmed,
  prev_new_confirmed,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - prev_new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed) AS growth_rate
FROM daily
WHERE prev_new_confirmed IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH yearly_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    SUBSTR(date, 1, 4) AS year,
    AVG(CAST(symptom_anosmia AS FLOAT64)) AS avg_weekly_freq
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_sub_region_2_weekly`
  WHERE sub_region_1 = 'New York'
    AND sub_region_2 IN ('Bronx County', 'Queens County', 'Kings County', 'New York County', 'Richmond County')
    AND date >= '2019-01-01' AND date <= '2020-12-31'
    AND symptom_anosmia IS NOT NULL AND symptom_anosmia != ''
  GROUP BY SUBSTR(date, 1, 4)
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2020' THEN avg_weekly_freq ELSE NULL END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2019' THEN avg_weekly_freq ELSE NULL END), 
              SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2019' THEN avg_weekly_freq ELSE NULL END)) * 100 AS pct_change
FROM yearly_avg

SELECT 
  za.zipcode,
  za.zipcode_geom AS polygon,
  za.area_land_meters,
  za.area_water_meters,
  za.latitude,
  za.longitude,
  za.state_code,
  za.state_name,
  za.city,
  za.county,
  COALESCE(male_pop.population, 0) + COALESCE(female_pop.population, 0) AS total_population
FROM `bigquery-public-data.utility_us.zipcode_area` za
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT zipcode, SUM(population) AS population
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010`
  WHERE gender = 'male'
  GROUP BY zipcode
) male_pop ON za.zipcode = male_pop.zipcode
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT zipcode, SUM(population) AS population
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010`
  WHERE gender = 'female'
  GROUP BY zipcode
) female_pop ON za.zipcode = female_pop.zipcode
WHERE ST_DWITHIN(
  ST_GEOGPOINT(za.longitude, za.latitude),
  ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.3321, 47.6062),
  10000
)

WITH tract_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    t11.geo_id,
    t11.total_pop as pop_2011,
    t18.total_pop as pop_2018,
    t11.median_income as income_2011,
    t18.median_income as income_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(t18.total_pop - t11.total_pop, t11.total_pop) AS pop_pct_change,
    (t18.median_income - t11.median_income) AS income_abs_change
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2011_5yr` t11
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` t18
    ON t11.geo_id = t18.geo_id
  WHERE t11.geo_id LIKE '36047%'
    AND t11.total_pop > 1000
    AND t18.total_pop > 1000
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id,
    pop_2011,
    pop_2018,
    income_2011,
    income_2018,
    pop_pct_change,
    income_abs_change,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pop_pct_change DESC) AS pop_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY income_abs_change DESC) AS income_rank
  FROM tract_changes
)
SELECT 
  geo_id,
  pop_2011,
  pop_2018,
  ROUND(pop_pct_change * 100, 2) AS pop_pct_change_pct,
  income_2011,
  income_2018,
  income_abs_change,
  pop_rank,
  income_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE pop_rank <= 20 AND income_rank <= 20
ORDER BY pop_rank

SELECT 
  shot_type,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN event_coord_x ELSE 1128 - event_coord_x END), 2) AS avg_x,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN 600 - event_coord_y ELSE event_coord_y END), 2) AS avg_y,
  COUNT(*) AS total_attempts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN shot_made THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_makes,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN shot_made THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*)), 4) AS make_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
WHERE scheduled_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-03-15 00:00:00')
  AND shot_type IS NOT NULL
  AND event_coord_x IS NOT NULL
  AND event_coord_y IS NOT NULL
  AND shot_type != ''
GROUP BY shot_type
ORDER BY shot_type

WITH utah_counties AS (
  SELECT county_fips_code, county_name 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.counties` 
  WHERE state_fips_code = '49'
),
avg_2000 AS (
  SELECT 
    geoid,
    AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_emplvl_2000
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX IN ('q1', 'q2', 'q3', 'q4')
    AND geoid LIKE '49%'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
avg_2018 AS (
  SELECT 
    geoid,
    AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_emplvl_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX IN ('q1', 'q2', 'q3', 'q4')
    AND geoid LIKE '49%'
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT 
  uc.county_name,
  uc.county_fips_code,
  a2000.avg_emplvl_2000,
  a2018.avg_emplvl_2018,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(a2018.avg_emplvl_2018 - a2000.avg_emplvl_2000, a2000.avg_emplvl_2000) * 100 AS pct_increase
FROM utah_counties uc
LEFT JOIN avg_2000 a2000 ON uc.county_fips_code = a2000.geoid
LEFT JOIN avg_2018 a2018 ON uc.county_fips_code = a2018.geoid
WHERE a2000.avg_emplvl_2000 IS NOT NULL AND a2018.avg_emplvl_2018 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH bls_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percent_white) as avg_white,
        AVG(percent_black_or_african_american) as avg_black,
        AVG(percent_asian) as avg_asian,
        AVG(percent_hispanic_or_latino) as avg_hispanic
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18` 
    WHERE year = 2021 
    AND (subsector IN ('Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals', 'Software publishers', 'Data processing, hosting, and related services') 
    OR (industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services' AND subsector = 'Professional and technical services'))
),
google AS (
    SELECT race_white, race_black, race_asian, race_hispanic_latinx
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_hiring`
    WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
race_diffs AS (
    SELECT 'White' as race, ABS(g.race_white - b.avg_white) * 100 as pct_diff
    FROM google g, bls_avg b
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Black or African American', ABS(g.race_black - b.avg_black) * 100
    FROM google g, bls_avg b
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Asian', ABS(g.race_asian - b.avg_asian) * 100
    FROM google g, bls_avg b
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Hispanic or Latinx', ABS(g.race_hispanic_latinx - b.avg_hispanic) * 100
    FROM google g, bls_avg b
)
SELECT race, ROUND(pct_diff, 2) as pct_diff
FROM race_diffs
ORDER BY pct_diff DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS theft_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_crime.crime`
  WHERE primary_type = 'MOTOR VEHICLE THEFT'
    AND year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2016
  GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT 
  year,
  MAX(theft_count) AS highest_motor_thefts_in_month
FROM monthly_counts
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

SELECT
  TradeReportID AS tradeID,
  MaturityDate AS tradeTimestamp,
  CASE
    WHEN LEFT(TargetCompID, 4) = 'MOMO' THEN 'Momentum'
    WHEN LEFT(TargetCompID, 4) = 'LUCK' THEN 'Feeling Lucky'
    WHEN LEFT(TargetCompID, 4) = 'PRED' THEN 'Prediction'
  END AS algorithm,
  Symbol AS symbol,
  LastPx AS openPrice,
  StrikePrice AS closePrice,
  s.Side AS tradeDirection,
  CASE WHEN s.Side = 'SHORT' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS tradeMultiplier
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cymbal_investments.trade_capture_report`,
UNNEST(Sides) AS s
ORDER BY closePrice DESC
LIMIT 6

-- Final query: Top 10 evaluation groups by largest subplot acres for inventory year 2012
WITH condition_acres AS (
    SELECT 
        p.evaluation_group,
        p.evaluation_group_description,
        p.evaluation_type,
        p.evaluation_description,
        p.state_code,
        c.condition_status_code,
        SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot, 1) * COALESCE(c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0)) as subplot_acres,
        SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, 0) * COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0)) as macroplot_acres
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c 
        ON p.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number 
        AND p.inventory_year = c.inventory_year
    WHERE p.inventory_year = 2012
    GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, p.state_code, c.condition_status_code
),
group_max AS (
    SELECT 
        evaluation_group,
        evaluation_group_description,
        evaluation_type,
        evaluation_description,
        state_code,
        condition_status_code,
        macroplot_acres,
        subplot_acres,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC) as rn
    FROM condition_acres
),
top_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        evaluation_group,
        evaluation_group_description,
        evaluation_type,
        evaluation_description,
        state_code,
        condition_status_code,
        macroplot_acres,
        subplot_acres
    FROM group_max
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    evaluation_group,
    evaluation_group_description,
    evaluation_type,
    evaluation_description,
    state_code,
    condition_status_code,
    macroplot_acres,
    subplot_acres
FROM top_groups
ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10
SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.gbif.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES` WHERE table_name = 'occurrences'

-- Final query: rate per 100k for all states for 2015 and 2016, then top 5 per year
WITH distracted_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    d.state_number,
    a.state_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.consecutive_number) as distracted_accidents
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2015` d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015` a 
    ON d.state_number = a.state_number AND d.consecutive_number = a.consecutive_number
  WHERE d.driver_distracted_by_name NOT IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported')
  GROUP BY d.state_number, a.state_name
),
distracted_2016 AS (
  SELECT 
    d.state_number,
    a.state_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.consecutive_number) as distracted_accidents
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2016` d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016` a 
    ON d.state_number = a.state_number AND d.consecutive_number = a.consecutive_number
  WHERE d.driver_distracted_by_name NOT IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported')
  GROUP BY d.state_number, a.state_name
),
state_pop AS (
  SELECT 
    SAFE_CAST(za.state_fips AS INT64) as state_fips,
    za.state_name,
    SUM(p.population) as total_pop
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010` p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.utility_us.zipcode_area` za ON p.zipcode = za.zipcode
  WHERE p.gender IS NULL AND p.minimum_age IS NULL
  GROUP BY SAFE_CAST(za.state_fips AS INT64), za.state_name
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    '2015' as year,
    d.state_number,
    d.state_name,
    d.distracted_accidents,
    sp.total_pop,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(d.distracted_accidents * 100000.0, sp.total_pop) as rate_per_100k
  FROM distracted_2015 d
  JOIN state_pop sp ON d.state_number = sp.state_fips
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    '2016' as year,
    d.state_number,
    d.state_name,
    d.distracted_accidents,
    sp.total_pop,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(d.distracted_accidents * 100000.0, sp.total_pop) as rate_per_100k
  FROM distracted_2016 d
  JOIN state_pop sp ON d.state_number = sp.state_fips
)
SELECT year, state_number, state_name, distracted_accidents, total_pop, 
       ROUND(rate_per_100k, 2) as rate_per_100k
FROM combined
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY rate_per_100k DESC) <= 5
ORDER BY year, rate_per_100k DESC

SELECT 
  state_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN atmospheric_conditions_name = 'Rain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rainy_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN atmospheric_conditions_name = 'Clear' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clear_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN atmospheric_conditions_name = 'Rain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN atmospheric_conditions_name = 'Clear' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff
FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016`
WHERE day_of_week IN (1, 7)  -- Sunday=1, Saturday=7
  AND atmospheric_conditions_name IN ('Rain', 'Clear')
GROUP BY state_name
ORDER BY ABS(diff) DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT 
    fips.GeoName AS county_name,
    snap.SNAP_All_Participation_Households AS total_snap_households,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
        (acs.income_less_10000 + acs.income_10000_14999 + acs.income_15000_19999),
        snap.SNAP_All_Participation_Households
    ) AS income_under_20k_ratio
FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_snap_enrollment.snap_enrollment` snap
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr` acs
    ON snap.FIPS = acs.geo_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_bea_cainc30.fips` fips
    ON snap.FIPS = fips.GeoFIPS AND fips.Year = DATE('2017-01-01')
WHERE snap.Date = DATE('2017-01-01')
    AND snap.SNAP_All_Participation_Households > 0
ORDER BY total_snap_households DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH births AS (
  SELECT 
    County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) as birth_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as no_morbidity_births,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1) THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as total_with_morbidity_info
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2018 AND Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1)
  GROUP BY County_of_Residence_FIPS, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year)
),
data_2016 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    CAST(b.no_morbidity_births AS FLOAT64) / CAST(b.total_with_morbidity_info AS FLOAT64) as pct_no_morbidity,
    CAST(c.poverty AS FLOAT64) / NULLIF(CAST(c.pop_determined_poverty_status AS FLOAT64), 0) as poverty_rate
  FROM births b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr` c 
    ON LPAD(b.County_of_Residence_FIPS, 5, '0') = c.geo_id
  WHERE b.birth_year = 2016 
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
data_2017 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    CAST(b.no_morbidity_births AS FLOAT64) / CAST(b.total_with_morbidity_info AS FLOAT64) as pct_no_morbidity,
    CAST(c.poverty AS FLOAT64) / NULLIF(CAST(c.pop_determined_poverty_status AS FLOAT64), 0) as poverty_rate
  FROM births b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr` c 
    ON LPAD(b.County_of_Residence_FIPS, 5, '0') = c.geo_id
  WHERE b.birth_year = 2017 
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
data_2018 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    CAST(b.no_morbidity_births AS FLOAT64) / CAST(b.total_with_morbidity_info AS FLOAT64) as pct_no_morbidity,
    CAST(c.poverty AS FLOAT64) / NULLIF(CAST(c.pop_determined_poverty_status AS FLOAT64), 0) as poverty_rate
  FROM births b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr` c 
    ON LPAD(b.County_of_Residence_FIPS, 5, '0') = c.geo_id
  WHERE b.birth_year = 2018 
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 2016 as year, poverty_rate, pct_no_morbidity FROM data_2016
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2017 as year, poverty_rate, pct_no_morbidity FROM data_2017
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2018 as year, poverty_rate, pct_no_morbidity FROM data_2018
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(poverty_rate) as sum_x,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y,
    SUM(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_xy,
    SUM(poverty_rate * poverty_rate) as sum_x2,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y2
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
  year,
  n,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y,
    SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y))
  ) as pearson_correlation
FROM stats

WITH users_2021 AS (
  SELECT id, creation_date, DATE_TRUNC(creation_date, MONTH) as signup_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creation_date) = 2021
),
user_counts AS (
  SELECT signup_month, COUNT(*) as total_users
  FROM users_2021
  GROUP BY signup_month
),
first_questions AS (
  SELECT 
    u.id as user_id,
    u.creation_date,
    u.signup_month,
    MIN(p.creation_date) as first_question_date
  FROM users_2021 u
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id
  WHERE p.creation_date >= u.creation_date 
    AND p.creation_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(u.creation_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY u.id, u.creation_date, u.signup_month
),
users_asked AS (
  SELECT signup_month, COUNT(*) as users_asked
  FROM first_questions
  GROUP BY signup_month
),
first_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    fq.user_id,
    fq.first_question_date,
    fq.signup_month,
    MIN(pa.creation_date) as first_answer_date
  FROM first_questions fq
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa ON pa.owner_user_id = fq.user_id
  WHERE pa.creation_date > fq.first_question_date

  GROUP BY fq.user_id, fq.first_question_date, fq.signup_month
),
users_answered AS (

  FROM first_answers
  GROUP BY signup_month
)
SELECT

  uc.total_users,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(ua.users_asked * 100.0, uc.total_users), 2) as pct_asked_within_30_days,

FROM user_counts uc

LEFT JOIN users_answered ua2 ON uc.signup_month = ua2.signup_month
ORDER BY uc.signup_month

    ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd AS session_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20201130'
    AND event_name = 'purchase'
    AND ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd IS NOT NULL
),
user_session_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ga_session_id) AS purchase_session_count,
    AVG(session_revenue) AS avg_purchase_revenue_per_session
  FROM purchase_sessions
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ga_session_id) > 1
)
SELECT 
  user_pseudo_id,
  avg_purchase_revenue_per_session
FROM user_session_stats
ORDER BY user_pseudo_id

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    REGEXP_REPLACE(
      REGEXP_REPLACE(ep.value.string_value, r'https?://[^/]*(/.*)', r'\1'), 
      r'/+', '/'
    ) as cleaned_path
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) as ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND ep.key = 'page_location'
    AND (ep.value.string_value LIKE '%shop.googlemerchandisestore.com%' 
         OR ep.value.string_value LIKE 'http://shop.googlemerchandisestore.com%')
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    cleaned_path,
    COUNT(*) as page_views,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
  FROM page_views
  GROUP BY cleaned_path
)
SELECT cleaned_path
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 2
